name: NL8802 (Nisshinbo bipolar dual audio op-amp, entry-level MUSES-derived)
tagline: Nisshinbo's Nov 2023 entry-level MUSES-derived bipolar dual (5.5 nV/√Hz, 45 MHz, ±22 V). Japanese hobbyist listening tests rank it with or above MUSES8820.
technology: Bipolar-input dual op-amp on a bipolar process (vendor: 'bipolar input and bipolar technology'). Nisshinbo says it applies the 'MUSES' high-quality-sound technology to a more productive process and calls it the entry-level model that carries MUSES technology. Die, topology and compensation are not disclosed.

part_numbers.notes: Base part number. At launch the package was EMP-8-AN (SMD, SOP-8 class). A small DFN3030-8-GQ (DFN8-W1) version was announced as under development; its orderable part number was not found. No DIP-8 version was seen.

Orderable EMP-8 part. Profusion calls it 'NL8802AN Bipolar Input Dual Op Amp', so 'AN' matches the EMP-8-AN package outline code. The meaning of the rest of the suffix ('AE1S', probably packing/taping) is unverified.

lineage.notes: Nisshinbo Micro Devices (formerly New Japan Radio/JRC, maker of MUSES) launched it on 28 Nov 2023 as the entry-level MUSES-technology audio op-amp. Its JFET-input sibling is NL8902. No second sources are known.

key_specs.condition: f = 1 kHz (full test conditions not seen)

reputation.summary: A niche Japanese part with a small hobbyist following. Nisshinbo markets it as the entry-level model carrying MUSES sound technology, balancing sound, performance and cost. The blogger new_western_elec compared it with MUSES8820 in September 2025 ('MUSES8820とNL8802、MUSES8920とNL8902を聴く'). Per the search summary the verdict depended on genre: MUSES8820 for loud rock, NL8802 for recent anime music. A ranking of OPA2604 < MUSES8820 < MUSES8920 < NL8802 < NL8902 appears in the Japanese comparisons found, but it is unclear whether it comes from nw-electric or from ns-kobo's NS phonoEQ 2 op-amp comparison. No objective third-party measurements were found (Audio Science Review or similar).
sonic_descriptors: suited to recent anime/pop more than MUSES8820, which suits loud rock (new_western_elec, 2025)
ranked above MUSES8820 and MUSES8920 but below NL8902 in one Japanese hobbyist ranking (attribution unclear)
clearer bass definition than MUSES8820D (earlier draft claim; unconfirmed)
typical_uses: Audio preamplifiers, active filters and line amplifiers (vendor)
Home, professional, car and portable audio (vendor target markets)
Hobbyist op-amp swaps in place of MUSES8820 / NJM4580-class duals, needing an SOP-to-DIP adapter because no DIP-8 version was seen
caveats: The praise rests on a few Japanese hobbyist listening tests, and one of them gave a genre-dependent verdict rather than a clear win over MUSES8820.
The package is SMD only (EMP-8; DFN3030-8 announced). Socket swaps need adapter boards, and stability of a 45 MHz GBW part on adapters is unverified.
Only a Ver.1.0 datasheet (NL8802_S_E, Mouser mirror) was seen. Output drive, capacitive-load stability and full THD+N conditions were not checked in this pass.

revision_history.changes: Earliest and only version seen (Mouser mirror). EMP-8-AN in production; DFN3030-8-GQ under development. Later versions, such as one that releases the DFN or a full-length datasheet, were not found.

counterfeit_notes: No NL8802 counterfeits or remarked parts were found. The part is recent (2023) and SMD only, so the DIP-8 fakes that plague MUSES8820 / MUSES8920 do not apply directly. Any 'NL8802 DIP-8' listing should be treated as suspect, because Nisshinbo lists only EMP-8-AN and DFN3030-8-GQ. Buy from authorised distributors (Mouser, Profusion, Japanese authorised shops) and check the top marking against the datasheet.
alternatives: NJM4580 / NJM2114 (lower-cost Nisshinbo bipolar audio duals)
LME49720 / LM4562 and OPA1612 (Western low-distortion bipolar duals)

refuted_claims: The claim that NL8802 is a 2025 product is wrong. Nisshinbo launched it on 28 Nov 2023 (https://www.nisshinbo-microdevices.co.jp/en/about/info/20231128.html). The EBV '/npi/2025/' page is only a later distributor listing.
corrections: Tagline, lineage period and status changed from 2025 to a Nov 2023 launch.

Reputation changed: new_western_elec's Sept 2025 verdict depended on genre (MUSES8820 for loud rock, NL8802 for recent anime music), not an outright preference over MUSES8820D. The ranking OPA2604 < ... < NL8902 is found in the Japanese comparisons, but its attribution to nw-electric is unclear (possibly ns-kobo). The 'clearer bass than MUSES8820D' descriptor is marked unconfirmed.
Added confirmed specs: 5.5 nV/√Hz at 1 kHz, THD 0.00005% at 1 kHz, GBW 45 MHz, SR 11 V/µs, Iq 8.0 mA (dual), ±3.0 V to ±22 V, bipolar input and process.

Packages resolved: EMP-8-AN (orderable NL8802ANAE1S, where 'AN' = package outline code) and DFN3030-8-GQ announced as under development. No DIP-8 version was seen, so the caveats and counterfeit notes were updated.
Added the Mouser mirror of datasheet Ver.1.0 (file NL8802_S_E) and a revision-history entry.
No silicon changes or PCNs were found, so silicon_changes stays empty.
claims_confirmed: Nisshinbo launched NL8802 on 28 Nov 2023 as a low-noise, high-voltage, dual high-quality-sound audio op-amp (https://www.nisshinbo-microdevices.co.jp/en/about/info/20231128.html; https://www.phileweb.com/news/audio/202311/29/24901.html).

It is the entry-level model that inherits MUSES technology and 'applies MUSES technology to a more productive technology' (https://www.nisshinbo-microdevices.co.jp/en/products/operational-amplifier/spec/?product=nl8802; https://www.mouser.com/new/nisshinbo/nisshinbo-nl8802-dual-op-amp/).

Specs: 5.5 nV/√Hz at 1 kHz, 0.00005% THD at 1 kHz, 45 MHz GBW, 11 V/µs, 8.0 mA dual Iq, ±3.0 V to ±22 V, bipolar input and bipolar technology (https://www.mouser.com/new/nisshinbo/nisshinbo-nl8802-dual-op-amp/).
Mouser hosts datasheet 'NL8802 High Quality Sound Dual Operational Amplifier' Ver.1.0 (https://www.mouser.com/datasheet/2/294/nl8802_s_e-3435312.pdf).
Packages are EMP-8-AN and DFN3030-8-GQ, with the DFN under development at launch (https://www.phileweb.com/news/audio/202311/29/24901.html).

Orderable part NL8802ANAE1S is listed at Mouser (https://www.mouser.com/ProductDetail/Nisshinbo/NL8802ANAE1S?qs=jRuttqqUwMTBHsU0xW9tgQ%3D%3D) and Profusion as 'NL8802AN' (https://gb.profusion.uk/uk/nl8802anae1s).
The new_western_elec blog post 'MUSES8820とNL8802、MUSES8920とNL8902を聴く' exists and compares NL8802 with MUSES8820 (https://nw-electric.way-nifty.com/blog/2025/09/post-02dac7.html).

revision_chain_notes: NL8802 has one vendor and no second sources. Nisshinbo Micro Devices (formerly New Japan Radio/JRC) launched it on 2023-11-28. There is only one datasheet document, NL8802_S_E (English). The chain known so far, oldest to newest: Ver.1.0 (undated, launch era around Nov 2023). Only one copy holds it, the Mouser mirror https://www.mouser.com/datasheet/2/294/nl8802_s_e-3435312.pdf, whose title reads 'Datasheet NL8802 High Quality Sound Dual Operational Amplifier - 1 - Ver.1.0'. Four WebSearch calls turned up no copy showing any other version. A targeted search for 'Ver.1.1', 'Ver.2.0', 'nl8802_e.pdf' and 'nl8802_j.pdf' returned only the Ver.1.0 Mouser copy. The Japanese launch press releases (PR TIMES, Nikkan, PHILE WEB 2023-11-29) still list DFN3030-8-GQ as 'under development'. That matches the Ver.1.0 state, and no later revision releasing the DFN package was found. Missing links: (1) the exact date of Ver.1.0; (2) any later Ver.x (for example a revision that moves the DFN3030-8-GQ package to production, or a full-length datasheet replacing the short-form '_S_' edition); (3) the Japanese-language edition (for example NL8802_S_J) and its Ver.; (4) the vendor-hosted PDF URL on nisshinbo-microdevices.co.jp. Third-party mirrors (alldatasheet, datasheet4u, LCSC, Digi-Key) did not show up for NL8802 in these searches. An LCSC datasheet (C189960) appeared in the results but is not shown to be NL8802, so it was excluded. The new additions are distributor or press pages only (mouser.de, Endrich, Profusion, Macnica, PR TIMES, Nikkan, PHILE WEB, IPROS). None of their summaries shows a datasheet revision.
